visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a dimly lit, professional-grade Mahjong parlor. A young woman with long black hair, wearing a black trench coat and a gold necklace, is seen in a close-up, carefully arranging her Mahjong tiles. The lighting is soft but focused on the green-backed tiles. (2) The camera cuts between other players around the table: a bald man in a white graphic t-shirt and a man with glasses. They are laughing and interacting casually. The background shows a modern entertainment space with another Mahjong table and a logo that reads '默和 MOHE' on the wall. (3) Detailed close-ups follow the hands of the players as they discard and draw tiles. The woman in the black coat maintains a calm expression until her eyes suddenly glow a bright, supernatural red. (4) Red and purple atmospheric smoke begins to swirl around the characters. The woman in black grabs the bald man by the throat in a dramatic, slow-motion struggle. The lighting shifts to a high-contrast red hue, intensifying the conflict. (5) A sudden cut transition leads to an outdoor night scene on an urban street. A large-scale explosion erupts in front of the '默和' storefront, sending orange flames and dark smoke into the air. Parked motorcycles are visible in the foreground. (6) The scene returns indoors where a woman in a white t-shirt lies on the ground surrounded by embers and small fires. The red-eyed woman stands over her with an authoritative posture. (7) The video concludes with a black screen featuring white text indicating a cliffhanger, followed by a rapid scroll of production credits and brand logos.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sharp, percussive clacking of Mahjong tiles being moved across a table, followed by several voices overlapping in enthusiastic Mandarin, declaring wins ('Hu'). The acoustic environment is clean with moderate room tone. (2) A transition sound (Whoosh) occurs as the tone of the voices shifts from playful to intense. A low-frequency synthesizer drone enters the mix, increasing harmonic tension. (3) Supernatural sound effects, including shimmering high-frequency swells and deep spectral booms, are introduced as the female voice takes on a more authoritative, slightly distorted quality. (4) A loud, broadband explosion sound with a significant low-end 'thump' and a long reverb tail punctuates the outdoor scene, followed by the crackling high-frequency texture of fire. (5) The final segment features a cinematic orchestral BGM with driving percussion and dark brass layers, accompanying an Indonesian vocal track that sounds otherworldly and strained. The audio concludes with a dramatic musical sting over the credits.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a high-production, narrative short film that blends common lifestyle activities (Mahjong) with supernatural drama to engage a social media audience and promote the brand '默和 MOHE' and '17LIVE'.
